title: Projects table schema and migration
description: Define the projects table schema with all fields for project tracking including type, status, progress, points, level, sharing, and GitHub integration fields. Soft deletion support required.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key to users.id with cascade delete
All ENUM fields (type, status) use Drizzle pgEnum
Running db:migrate creates the table correctly
TypeScript types User and NewUser exported

steps.description: Define enums for project type and status
steps.details: In server/src/db/schema/projects.ts, define: export const projectTypeEnum = pgEnum('project_type', ['software', 'design', 'physical', 'content', 'learning', 'other']); export const projectStatusEnum = pgEnum('project_status', ['active', 'on_hold', 'completed', 'archived']);

Define pgTable 'projects': id (uuid pk defaultRandom), user_id (uuid notNull references users.id onDelete cascade), name (varchar 255 notNull), description (text nullable), type (projectTypeEnum notNull default 'other'), status (projectStatusEnum notNull default 'active'), progress_auto (integer notNull default 0), progress_manual (integer nullable), points_total (integer notNull default 0), level (varchar 50 notNull default 'Seed'), share_token (uuid nullable unique), is_public (boolean notNull default false), github_repo_id (varchar 255 nullable), github_repo_name (varchar 500 nullable), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()), updated_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()), deleted_at (timestamp nullable).
Add: userIdIdx = index on projects.user_id (for fetching all user projects), shareTokenIdx = index on projects.share_token (for public share lookup).

steps.description: Export types and add to schema barrel
steps.details: Export type Project = typeof projects.$inferSelect; export type NewProject = typeof projects.$inferInsert; Add 'export * from ./projects' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Connect to DB and run \d projects to verify all columns. Check that the foreign key to users is present. Verify the UNIQUE constraint on share_token.

technicalNotes: pgEnum creates a PostgreSQL ENUM type — must be referenced in the table definition
progress_auto is computed by the server; progress_manual is the user override
The level field is a VARCHAR computed by the level service from points_total, stored for fast reads
